title: Brief to Klaviyo campaign, with AI copy, on-brand banners and an approval step
systemName: Your brief to Klaviyo campaign workflow

facts: Post: LA fine jewelry DTC brand on Shopify and Klaviyo; wants brief (offer, product, theme, date) to ready-to-review Klaviyo campaign, AI copy with A/B, on-brand banners from real product images, Shopify product pull, Klaviyo build via API, optional SMS/social, human approval before send.
Tools listed by the post: Klaviyo API, Shopify API, OpenAI/Claude, AI image tools incl. Bannerbear/Placid, Make/Zapier/n8n. No client name in the post; U-006 fallback 'your team'.
Rebuild of the 7:03 PM live tour on the legacy sales-deck template per Lorenzo 7:33 PM CT. Same story and sample data as tour/tour.html.

scenes.caption: The workflow pulls your products, writes the copy, renders the banner and builds the campaign.
